title: 第十章 赖账第十一章 求饶第十二章 龙犀血脉第三更
lines: “好了，你说你招收了四个学生，你现在是把学生都找过来，让我们确认呢，还是伸着脸等我们抽？”
见这个倒数第一居然嚣张的要和他们四人同时打赌，钱彪冷冷一笑。
“把学生找来？”张悬摇摇头：“各位都是后勤处的老师，不会连最简答的事都不知道吧！想证实我有没有招收到四个学生很简单，只要有学员在我的令牌上滴血认主，教导处就会自动形成身份信息，去教导处查查，就可以一清二楚，教导处不可能和我一起来哄骗你们吧！”
和只要学生身份验证，讯息会自动传送到教导处，在那里会有详细记载，任何人都做不了假！
“李元，你过去看看！我倒要看看，这家伙过一会还怎么装逼！”
听到他的话，和自信的面容，钱彪一愣，随即转头吩咐一句。
李元正是刚才嘲笑张悬的其中一位老师，听到吩咐，转身走了出去。
教导处和后勤处都属于行政部门，距离并不远，李元走出去，时间不长，就一脸难看的走了回来。
“怎么样？”
见他这副模样，钱彪心中“咯噔！”，冒出不祥的预感。
“是有……四个学员拜他为师！这是他们的名单和详细信息……”
李元脸色铁青。
他到现在都不敢相信是真的。
这四个学员眼睛瞎了吗？洪天学院这么多老师不挑，偏偏挑一个师资考核得零分，啥玩意都不会的家伙！
“我看看，别他找了一些瞎眼、瘸腿随时都会被开除的家伙，当自己学生！”
钱彪一把拿过名单。
剩下两个老师也急忙围了过来。
不少老师为了增加自己的学生数量，会弄一些差生抵数，这些人随时都会被开除，就算留着，也坚持不了几个月！
在钱彪看来，张悬这种倒数第一的家伙，就算能招收到学生，也肯定是最差，最烂，没人要的学员。
收这种人，只为了凑数，非但没有任何骄傲，还会更丢人！
“王颖……是个女生？一听名字就不怎么样，估计是入学考试最差的几个之一……”看到了名单上第一个名字，钱彪冷哼出声。
并不是任何人都能进入洪天学院的，想要进来，首先要进行入学考核，学院会根据他们的成绩进行排名，达到资格，才会被录取。
入学考核排名靠前的，基本都是优秀老师争抢的对象，个个都非常有名，貌似没有这位叫做王颖的。
“钱老师，你继续看……”钱彪的话还没说完，就听到身边一个老师略微发颤的声音。
“怎么了？难道比我说的还差？”
一声冷笑，钱彪向下看去，只看了一眼，瞳孔不由自主的收缩，只见王颖后面带着关于她的详细注释：“新生入学考核第六十七名，长老学员王涛的妹妹，天玄城四大世家之一王家千金！”
“王家千金？王涛的妹妹？”钱彪倒抽一口冷气。
天玄王国，有四大家族，王家正是其一，这个家族的千金小姐拜这个师资考核倒数第一的家伙为师？真的假的？
这种人不是应该拜陆寻、王超他们吗？
如果单说家族，就让他畏惧，让他更崩溃的是这个王颖的哥哥，王涛！
前年的新生，入学后每年年级综合评比，都是前十的超强存在，今年更是被学院的一位长老看重，收为亲传！
哥哥这种天赋，妹妹怎么会差？
有势力，有天赋，还有个好哥哥，居然认这家伙为师？
我眼睛不会瞎了，看错了吧！
钱彪只觉得天雷阵阵，整个人都快要晕过去。
“你们再看下面的……”
就在他浑身抽搐，不敢相信的时候，另外一个老师又颤巍巍的喊道。
“能收到一个王颖就算他走了大运了，我不信他还能收到更厉害的……”一咬牙，钱彪顺着名单看下去，眼睛和一个名字一接触，全身再次一颤，眼前一黑。
“赵雅？年级考核第七名的赵雅？白玉城城主的千金？”
钱彪欲哭无泪。
刚说不信他还能再招到更厉害的学员，做梦都没想到，还真有……不仅如此，还是无数老师为之疯狂的超级大神！
这个赵雅，还没来他就听说过，是白玉城城主的女儿，人长得漂亮不说，天赋也十分厉害！
content_en:
"Okay, you said you recruited four students. Are you going to bring all the students over now and let us confirm, or are you just waiting for us to slap you?"
Seeing that the last place arrogantly wanted to bet with the four of them at the same time, Qian Biao smiled coldly.
"Find the students?" Zhang Xuan shook his head: "You are all teachers from the Logistics Department, don't you know the simplest things? It's very simple to confirm whether I have recruited four students. As long as a student identifies his master with blood on my token, the Teaching Office will automatically form identity information. If you go to the Teaching Office to check, you will know it clearly. There is no way the Teaching Office will come with me to deceive you!"
As long as the student's identity is verified, the information will be automatically sent to the teaching office, where there will be detailed records, and no one can fake it!
"Li Yuan, go over and take a look! I want to see how this guy keeps showing off after a while!"
Upon hearing his words and confident face, Qian Biao was stunned for a moment, then turned to give instructions.
Li Yuanzheng, one of the teachers who had just laughed at Zhang Xuan, turned around and walked out after hearing the order.
The Teaching Office and the Logistics Office both belong to administrative departments, and they are not far apart. Li Yuan walked out, and after a short time, he came back with an ugly look on his face.
"How's it going?"
Seeing his appearance, Qian Biao felt a thump in his heart and had an ominous premonition.
"There are...four students who worship him as their teacher! This is their list and detailed information..."
Li Yuan's face was ashen.
He still can't believe it's true.
Are these four students blind? There are so many teachers in Hongtian College who don’t choose, but they choose a guy who got zero points in the teacher assessment and doesn’t know anything!
"Let's see, don't let him find some blind, lame guys who will be expelled at any time to be his students!"
Qian Biao took the list.
The remaining two teachers also hurriedly gathered around.
In order to increase the number of students, many teachers will recruit some poor students to offset their grades. These students will be expelled at any time, and even if they are retained, they will not last for a few months!
In Qian Biao's view, even if a guy like Zhang Xuan, who is the last, can recruit students, he will definitely be the worst, the worst, and the most undesirable student.
Accepting people like this just to make up the numbers is not only devoid of any pride, but also even more embarrassing!
"Wang Ying... is a girl? The name doesn't sound very good. She is probably one of the worst in the entrance exam..." Qian Biao snorted coldly when he saw the first name on the list.
Not everyone can enter Hongtian College. If you want to enter, you must first take the entrance examination. The college will rank them according to their grades. Only those who meet the qualifications will be admitted.
Those who rank high in the entrance exam are basically the ones that outstanding teachers compete for. All of them are very famous. It seems that there is no one named Wang Ying.
"Teacher Qian, keep reading..." Before Qian Biao finished speaking, he heard the slightly trembling voice of a teacher next to him.
"What's wrong? Is it worse than what I said?"
With a sneer, Qian Biao looked down. His pupils shrank involuntarily, and he saw Wang Ying followed by a detailed note about her: "No. 67 in the freshman entrance examination, the sister of the elder student Wang Tao, the daughter of the Wang family, one of the four major families in Tianxuan City!"
"The daughter of the Wang family? Wang Tao's sister?" Qian Biao gasped.
There are four major families in the Tianxuan Kingdom, and the Wang family is one of them. The daughter of this family wants to be the teacher of this guy who ranks last in the teacher assessment? Real or fake?
Shouldn't this kind of people worship Lu Xun and Wang Chao?
If we talk about family alone, he is afraid. What makes him even more broken is Wang Ying's brother, Wang Tao!
The freshmen from the year before last were ranked among the top ten in the comprehensive evaluation of each year after they entered school. This year, they were valued by an elder of the college and accepted as a personal disciple!
How can my sister be so talented if my brother is so talented?
He has power, talent, and a good brother, but he actually considers this guy his teacher?
My eyes are not blind. I must have seen it wrong!
Qian Biao felt like thunder was coming from the sky, and he was about to faint.
"Look at what's next..."
Just when he was twitching all over and couldn't believe it, another teacher shouted tremblingly.
"If he can receive one Wang Ying, he is lucky. I don't believe he can receive something more powerful..." Gritting his teeth, Qian Biao looked down the list. As soon as his eyes came into contact with a name, his whole body trembled again and his vision went dark.
"Zhao Ya? Zhao Ya, who ranked seventh in the grade assessment? The daughter of the Lord of White Jade City?"
Qian Biao wanted to cry but had no tears.
I just said that I didn’t believe that he could recruit more powerful students. I never dreamed that there really was one... Not only that, he was also a super master that countless teachers were crazy about!
He had heard about this Zhao Ya before she came here. She was the daughter of the lord of White Jade City. Not only was she beautiful, but she was also very talented!
